verdict.rationale: Productboard provides agent-oriented credentials: OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration and PKCE for MCP clients, an OAuth authorization-code flow with consent screens, and personal access tokens. Admins can also restrict which roles may connect an agent. However, the evidence never documents granular scopes or per-token permission limits. Agents appear to inherit the signed-in user's access rather than receive a narrowly scoped credential. Missing for 10: documented granular OAuth/token scopes (e.g., read-only or per-entity), per-credential permission restriction for agents, independent corroboration.
